errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis represents the categories. In this horizontal bar chart, the categories are on the vertical axis, and the values are on the horizontal axis.
The description misquotes a category label. The chart shows "Външни утвърдени експерти" (External established experts), not "В нашия утвърдени експерти" (In our established experts).

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос представя броя на отговорите
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the vertical axis represents the number of responses. In this horizontal bar chart, the horizontal axis represents the number of responses.
The description claims the value axis has a label ('Брой отговори'), but no such label exists on the horizontal axis in the figure.
The description states that the numbers on the value axis are at intervals of 1, but the major ticks are clearly marked at intervals of 2 (0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10).
The description incorrectly reports the percentage for the highest bar as 100%. The chart explicitly labels this value as 10 (45,5%).
